sources.title: GitHub - silveraru/esmKCat: kcat prediction model using chemBERTa+ GINE ...
sources.snippet: A multi-modal deep learning model for kcat (catalytic rate constant) prediction that combines: ChemBERTa + GINE for substrate molecular representation ESM (Evolutionary Scale Modeling) for protein sequence representation GINE (Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge features) for protein 3D structure representation

sources.title: DOCX bioRxiv
sources.snippet: The ESM series includes models like ESM2 9 (for embeddings and general purposes), ESMFold 9 (for protein structure prediction), ESM-1v 5 (for variant effect prediction), and ESM-IF1 10 (for inverse folding). Both SaProt and ProSST seek to incorporate protein structural information into training of language model.
